modes.name: Shiyu Defense: Critical Node
sharedMechanics: In this stage, dealing DMG to enemies earns you DMG Score. Defeating a single normal/elite enemy will grant you an instance of Elimination Score.
In this stage, scores earned at different times will receive additional multiplier bonuses. The earlier in the challenge, the higher the multiplier. The total score cap (including bonus) is 50,000.

bosses.name: Autonomous Tactical Unit - Conqueror
mechanics: Agent Sharp DMG increases by 20%. After defeating normal enemies, Agents with the Stun specialty restore 15 Energy.
After being hit by an Agent's Chain Attack , enemies recover from Stun 15% slower for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Ionized Doppelganger Komano Manato
mechanics: Agent Ice DMG and Ether DMG increase by 25%, and their Ice and Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increase by 15%.
When an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the enemy's DEF decreases by 10% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Doppelganger - Starlight - Billy
mechanics: Agent Fire DMG and Electric DMG increase by 35%, and Daze dealt by Agents with the Stun specialty increases by 15%.
After an Agent stuns an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and they recover from Stun 15% slower for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Frigidity
selectableBuffs.description: Agent Ice DMG increases by 15%, and their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60. · When an Agent triggers Abloom or Disorder on an enemy, Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG dealt by the whole squad increase by 25%, and their Buildup Rate increases by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Defense Crusher
selectableBuffs.description: Daze dealt to enemies by Agents increases by 20%. · Agents with the Attack specialty have their ATK increased by 20%. After using Ultimate, their CRIT DMG increases by 50% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Knife Edge
selectableBuffs.description: Agent DEF increases by 15%, and their Sharp DMG increases by 15%. · For Agents with the Stun specialty, Daze dealt by their EX Special Attack increases by 20%. After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack or Special Attack, Electric DMG and Wind DMG increase by 30% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon
mechanics: After Scorched Horizon activates Gale Scorcher, they gain 5 stacks of Into Flames. Each stack of Into Flames increases DMG dealt by 10% and reduces CRIT DMG taken by 25%. With Into Flames stacks, every time Scorched Horizon is inflicted with an Anomaly, one stack of Into Flames is lost, and subsequent Abloom DMG taken increases by 10% for 15s (max 3 stacks). Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When Scorched Horizon is in Gale Scorcher state, Impairing them grants 1,250 Performance Points. Striking down Scorched Horizon when they're attacking in mid-air grants 1,500 Performance Points. Performing a Shutdown against Scorched Horizon's Control Skill grants 2,000 Performance Points. Max 5,000 Performance Points.
Suitable for Agents with Anomaly specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Infernal Revenant
mechanics: After Infernal Revenant enters the Infernal state, the Attribute Anomaly DMG it takes is reduced by 30%; every time Chain Parry is triggered, the Boss gains 1 stack of Overheat; triggering Defensive Assist or Perfect Dodge 2 times in total applies 1 stack of Overheat on the Boss, and each stack of Overheat increases CRIT DMG of the whole squad by 25%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 20s. Triggering Defensive Assist or retriggering Overheat resets the duration.
Successfully triggering Shutdown grants 2000 Performance Points; each flint shattered grants 1000 Performance Points, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Kusarikku
mechanics: Attribute Anomaly DMG taken by Kusarikku is reduced by 40%.

When an Agent successfully uses a Defensive Assist against Kusarikku's Rift Assault, applies 1 stack of Exposed to Kusarikku. When Kusarikku becomes Stunned, applies 2 stacks of Exposed. Each stack of Exposed increases the Laceration DMG Kusarikku receives by 10%. Exposed can stack up to 4 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

After Kusarikku activates Corruptive Barrier, use Defensive Assist to counter Kusarikku's Rift Assault and leave it Impaired to gain 1000 Performance Points; successfully countering a Rift Assault with Defensive Assist grants 700 Performance Points; executing a Shutdown on Kusarikku's Control Skill grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.
Suitable for Agents with Armorer specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Integrated - Girtablullu
mechanics: When an Agent's attack hits a Boss, the Boss gains 1 point of Dissonance. The same Agent can apply at most 1 point of Dissonance every 1s.

When a Boss accumulates 10 points of Dissonance, all Dissonance points are immediately removed and the Boss enters the Dissonant state. While in the Dissonant state, enemies take 40% bonus Attribute Anomaly DMG for 10s. Re-entering the Dissonant state resets the duration.

When an Agent successfully inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on a Boss, all Agents on the squad gain the Transmutation effect: DMG dealt increases by 15% and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20 points. The Transmutation effect lasts 10s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

Each time you successfully parry an attack from Girtablullu's summoned minions and trigger Active Conversion, you gain 500 Performance Points; successfully triggering Chain Parry against Girtablullu's attacks grants 1000 Performance Points, up to 3 times; if you successfully break the Corruptive Barrier within 25s of Girtablullu first activating Corruptive Barrier, you gain 1500 Performance Points. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 10,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 30,000 points within the time limit
